verdict.rationale: Rev AI's own site and docs claim 'comprehensive SDKs' and say you can 'integrate faster with SDKs and code samples', so official SDKs are a first-party claimed capability. But the evidence never names the languages, packages, install paths or SDK reference docs, so how far they go is unproven. Missing for 10: named SDK languages and packages, SDK reference documentation or code examples, maintenance/versioning details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
